api_pass.description: Password for KEMP LoadMaster API operations..

api_user.description: Username for KEMP LoadMaster API operations.

api_version.description: Use 1 for the old XML based API, 2 (default) for JSON.

port.description: The port on the Real Server to be used.

block.description: Provides a resource for Real Servers. Use this to create and manage Real Servers assigned to Virtual Services in the KEMP LoadMaster.

address.description: The IP address of the Virtual Service.

checkcodes.description: A space-separated list of HTTP status codes that should be treated as successful when received from the Real Server

checkport.description: The port to be checked. If a port is not specified, the Real Server port is used. Specify 0 to unset CheckPort.

checktype.description: Specify which protocol is to be used to check the health of the Real Server. (icmp, https, http, tcp, smtp, nntp, ftp, telnet, pop3, imap, rdp, bdata, ldap or none).

checkurl.description: When checktype is set to http or https - by default, the health checker tries to access the URL / to determine if the machine is available. A different URL can be set in the checkurl parameter. When the checktype is set to bdata: Specify a hexadecimal string to send to the Real Server.

defaultgw.description: Specify the Virtual Service-specific default gateway to be used and to send responses back to clients. If not set, the global default gateway will be used

enable.description: Enable or disable the virtual server.

layer.description: Network Layer for the service to run at (7 or 4).

nickname.description: Specifies the "friendly" name of the service.

port.description: The port for the Virtual Service.

protocol.description: The protocol to be used for the Virtual Service.

type.description: Specifies the type of service being load balanced (gen, http, http2, ts, tls, or log).

block.description: Provides a resource for Virtual Services. Use this to create and manage Virtual Services in the KEMP LoadMaster.

address.description: The IP address of the Virtual Service.

port.description: The port for the Virtual Service.

protocol.description: The protocol used for the Virtual Service.

block.description: Use this data source to retreive information about an existing Virtual Service.
